verdict.rationale: Groq is an API-first inference service, so it is headless by design. It uses API-key auth with OpenAI-compatible clients, ships an official server-side TypeScript SDK, and offers an asynchronous Batch API for large unattended workloads. All of this fits scripted or CI automation without any UI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
